name: product-discovery
description: Research and analysis workflows for product discovery: public customer research, affinity mapping, desk research, interview planning, and data analysis.

interface.longDescription: Turn public customer opinions, research notes, interview transcripts, business questions, and datasets into evidence-led product decisions.
defaultPrompt: Synthesize these interview transcripts with affinity mapping.
Research this product decision and challenge my assumptions.
Create an interview plan from these research notes.
Find public customer opinions about this product and create a short report with grouped quotes.
